CommandHelp.ACMD: [join|restart|jointeam_TeamName] ; [command1] ; [command2]...: Execute a command for the specified action. (e.g., acmd join addperk ; perk_u_t3_peripheralbinding ; spawnentity item_artifact_evaglove)

CommandHelp.AllowPVP: [True|False]: Controls whether PvP between players is allowed

CommandHelp.Invite: Open the Steam overlay to invite your friends.
CommandHelp.Join: [Lobby Name|Lobby id]:The name or ID of the lobby to join. It will first try to match by name; if no match is found, it will fall back to matching by ID.
CommandHelp.LobbyId: Get the current lobby ID and copy it to the clipboard.
CommandHelp.LobbyType: [Visibility=public|friends|private]:Visibility controls whether the lobby can be found by others.
CommandHelp.PCMD: [all|steamId] ; [command1] ; [command2]...: Execute a command for all players or a specific player. (e.g. pcmd 561198279116422 addperk ; perk_u_t3_peripheralbinding ; spawnentity item_artifact_evaglove)
CommandHelp.PVPRule: [DamageType] [DamageMultiplier] ...: Controls the damage multiplier for the specified damage type, or settings such as invincibility frames (Fire type requires FireTime and FireDamage settings).
CommandHelp.PlayerColor: [Preset|R G B]: Change the remote player model color. Presets: default, white, red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, pink, black.

CommandHelp.RemoveTeam: [Team Name]: Remove the team with the specified name. (default team cannot be removed)
CommandHelp.SetHost: [steamId]: Transfer host privileges. Match using the ID from allplayer.
CommandHelp.SetLobbyName: [Lobby Name]: Lobby Name is used for others to search for the lobby (it cannot contain spaces or ;).
CommandHelp.PlayerName: [Name]: Set the name displayed on your tag to others.
CommandHelp.SubtitleTalk: [Text]: Send a message to other players' subtitle area.
CommandHelp.TCMD: [teamname] ; [command1] ; [command2]...: Execute a command for all players in the specified team. (e.g., tcmd hunter addperk ; perk_u_t3_peripheralbinding ; spawnentity item_artifact_evaglove)
CommandHelp.Talk: [Text]: Send a message to other players.
